title: 生涯スポーツ演習(レクリエーションスポーツ)
subtitle: Academic Exercises on Lifelong Sports
courseType:
Student and Study Skills Courses Program
Character Building Courses
Lifelong Sports
educationalGoal: Through learning activities for Recreational Sports, students will: 1) Understand the pleasure derived from sports. 2) Acquire the knowledge and ability to practice various sports activities voluntarily through the PDCA cycle. 3) Learn the things that are needed for social/college life, such as observation of the rules, discipline, respect, a competitive spirit, leadership/followership abilities, responsibility, safety awareness, and communication skills.
advice: This class aims to achieve the above-mentioned learning objectives through recreational sports activities. Specifically, students will learn the following: Adopting the rules and basic technology of recreational sports, such as Indiaca, soft volleyball, and dodgeball, as light sports that can generally be enjoyed indoors by anyone. 1. Learn theory and practice through soft volleyball and Indiaca games. 2. Learn theory and practice through Futsal games. 3. Learn theory and practice through dodgeball games. 4. Learn how to run a sporting event. Lessons are held once per week (100 minutes). In practical classes, students should wear appropriate clothing such as sportswear, T-shirts, shorts, and outdoor shoes. Students should aim to attend all classes highly motivated to learn. Students should pay attention to their own health condition. Students need to participate while actively showing willingness to learn fundamental skills.
requiredKnowledge: Understanding the mental attitude and safety precautions needed in sports activities.

activityGoals.body: Be able to express the importance of enjoying an active sports lifestyle throughout your lifetime.
Be able to learn the fundamental skills needed for futsal and use them in learning activities.
Be able to evaluate and explain your own situation and improvements in sports activities based on the PDCA cycle
Be able to understand the necessities for social life and implement them in learning activities.
Be able to express problems and make improvements that promote a healthy lifestyle by assessing your daily life.
Be able to understand safety management in sports and implement this understanding in learning activities.
